Name: Stardrop Flower
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
Just changes the rabbit's foot item to my own creation, the Stardrop Flower, a vegan, animal-friendly universal loved gift. The colors are based on the colors of the stardrop. Also, Penny now loves it! It is still "dropped" by rabbits, how do they get the flowers, you ask? You can decide for yourself! I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3637]Rabbit Floof[/url] by DaisyNiko and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8648]Rabbit Clovers[/url] by LorenOlson/UnityandTheSystem. Check both their mods out, they are awesome!

Note:
For anyone using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3168]Elle's New Coop Animals[/url] by Elle/ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/39003995]junimods[/url] (a very excellent mod and mod creator, I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10039]Elle's Animals for Alternative Textures[/url], also excellent) make sure the config for replacing the rabbit's foot is set to false, otherwise, the mods will conflict and the regular rabbit's foot will show up instead. Thank you to Athelinda for pointing out the issue.

I have added i18n. If anyone wants to translate it, just send me the i18n files and I will add it to the mod!
